source_caption:
Eddie Redmayne’s chilling transformation into a master assassin relies on far more than just brilliant costuming. The actor worked extensively with dialect and movement coaches, completely altering his physical gait, posture, and vocal cadence for each complex disguise. This intense commitment elevates the classic cat-and-mouse thriller format into a compelling psychological exploration of what happens when a man weaponizes his own lack of identity.
⠀
The Day of the Jackal (2024–), created by Ronan Bennett, starring Eddie Redmayne, Lashana Lynch, Úrsula Corberó. A ruthlessly efficient, shape-shifting assassin meets his match when a tenacious British intelligence officer launches a relentless global manhunt to bring him down.
